messages:
Maya Patel: HelixCare procurement sent a vendor form mixing DPA + PCI items. They want encryption-at-rest details, CMK options, audit-log retention, and SOC2 scope. Deadline: Fri EOD or PO delayed.

Jordan Kim: I can coordinate replies. Liam, can you own the procurement form?

Liam O'Neil: Ill take it. Devon, can you paste short security-approved phrasings I can reuse?

Devon Chen: Short bullets you can paste: 
Q: Encryption at rest?
A: AES-256. Hosted uses provider-managed KMS; Dedicated and Private deployments support customer-managed KMS or HSM.

Q: Encryption in transit?
A: TLS 1.3 enforced for all in-flight traffic. Mutual TLS supported for Private.

Q: Audit logs & retention?
A: Audit logs (access events, admin actions, key rotations) retained 90 days by default for Hosted. Configurable up to 12 months for Dedicated/Private with enterprise add-on. Redacted sample events available under NDA.

Q: SOC2 scope?
A: Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II for our platform services. For Private/on-prem customers we provide documentation and evidence packages to support customer audits.

Liam O'Neil: Thanks  pasting now. Sent draft to procurement & HelixCare contact at 1779001333. Note added: "Hosted customers may request CMK support with enterprise contract; Private supports customer HSM." Flagging renewal risk: if PO delayed >2 weeks escalate to AE.

OnboardBot: Task created: \"HelixCare compliance reply\" assigned to Liam O'Neil, due 2025-11-07.

Liam O'Neil: HelixCare acknowledged at 1779001450. Follow-up: do you offer field-level tokenization for PII? Asking for specifics, looping in Devon.

Devon Chen: We offer application-level tokenization patterns today. For strict PCI field-level tokenization we recommend Private deployment with customer-managed HSM. Ill draft a short note to paste.

Maya Patel: Nice and concise. Keep this low-friction so procurement moves. If they request extra evidence, escalate to AE and engineering docs.
